location: Act 3, Scene 1 — A room in the prison (chapter 9), paragraph 3
modern_text: DUKE. Be absolute for death; either death or life shall be the sweeter for it. Reason with life like this: if I lose you, I lose a thing that none but fools would keep. A breath you are, servile to all the influences of the sky, that hourly afflict this dwelling where you reside. To put it plainly, you are death's fool, for you labour by your flight to shun him, and yet you run toward him still. You are not noble; for all the accommodations that you carry are nursed by baseness. You are by no means valiant; for you do fear the soft and tender fork of a poor worm. Your best of rest is sleep, and that you often provoke; yet grossly you fear your death, which is no more. You are not yourself; for you exist on many a thousand grains that issue out of dust. Happy you are not; for what you do not have, you still strive to get, and what you have, you forget. You are not certain; for your complexion shifts to strange effects after the moon. If you are rich, you are poor; for, like an ass whose back is bowed with ingots, you bear your heavy riches but a journey, and death unloads you. Friend have you none; for your own bowels, which call you father, the mere effusion of your own loins, do curse the gout, serpigo, and the rheum, for not ending you sooner. You have neither youth nor age, but, as it were, an after-dinner's sleep, dreaming on both — for all your blessed youth becomes as if aged, and begs the alms of palsied old age; and when you are old and rich, you have neither heat, affection, limb, nor beauty to make your riches pleasant. What's there in this that bears the name of life? Yet in this life lie hid a thousand more deaths. And yet death we fear, which makes these odds all even.

location: Act 1, Scene 1 — An apartment in the Duke's palace (chapter 1), paragraph 3
modern_text: DUKE. To explain to you the principles of government would seem like me making a show of fine speeches, since I know that your own expertise in this exceeds anything my advice could add. So nothing remains but to trust your sufficiency to act as your worth allows, and let your judgment do its work. The character of our people, our city's institutions, and the standards of common justice — in all these you are as well versed as study and experience have ever made anyone we know. Here is your commission, from which we don't want you to stray. Call him here, I say — bid Angelo come before us. [Exit an Attendant.] What kind of stand-in for me do you think he will make? For you should know, we have with special care chosen him to take our place in our absence; we've lent him our authority, dressed him in our love, and given his deputation every instrument of our own power. What do you think of it?
source_text: _Duke._ Of government the properties to unfold, Would seem in me to affect speech and discourse; Since I am put to know that your own science                         5 Exceeds, in that, the lists of all advice My strength can give you: then no more remains, But that to your sufficiency . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . as your worth is able, And let them work. The nature of our people,                        10 Our city's institutions, and the terms For common justice, you're as pregnant in As art and practice hath enriched any That we remember. There is our commission, From which we would not have you warp. Call hither,                 15 I say, bid come before us Angelo.    [_Exit an Attendant._ What figure of us think you he will bear? For you must know, we have with special soul Elected him our absence to supply; Lent him our terror, dress'd him with our love,                     20 And given his deputation all the organs Of our own power: what think you of it?

location: Act 2, Scene 1 — A hall in Angelo's house (chapter 5), paragraph 27
modern_text: ELBOW. By Mary, sir, by means of my wife; who, if she had been carnally inclined, might have been accused there of fornication, adultery, and every uncleanness.
source_text: _Elb._ Marry, sir, by my wife; who, if she had been a woman cardinally given, might have been accused in fornication, adultery, and all uncleanliness there.

modern_text: She, Claudio, that you wronged, look you restore. Joy to you, Mariana! Love her, Angelo: I have confessed her, and I know her virtue. Thanks, good friend Escalus, for your much goodness. There's more behind that is more gratulate. Thanks, provost, for your care and secrecy. We shall employ you in a worthier place. Forgive him, Angelo, that brought you home the head of Ragozine for Claudio's. The offence pardons itself. Dear Isabel, I have a motion much imports your good; whereto if you'll a willing ear incline, what's mine is yours, and what is yours is mine. So, bring us to our palace; where we'll show what's yet behind, that's meet you all should know.
